title: Segway Memphis
specs: See Downtown Memphis with rich history and iconic places
Insurance $5 per Segway damage coverage, payable on tour day unless proof of own insurance provided
Tours available for groups of 2 to 6 people
blurb: Guests take guided Segway tours around Downtown Memphis, choosing between River View, City View, or a combined two-hour tour covering both areas. Tours include historical stories and visits to landmarks such as Beale Street, the Peabody Hotel, and the Civil Rights Museum. Tours are available for groups of 2 to 6 people.
extraNote: All tours are subject to tax and $5 insurance per Segway not included in price
